title: Input-conditioned Mirror composition over a learned soft-prompt pool
dataset: WikiText-2 raw, eight source articles per prompt bank; held-out suffix queries
hypothesis: An input-conditioned rank-2 coefficient View that composes a shared soft-prompt pool can match per-task oracle prompt quality with no private prompt duplication and outperform native top-1 L2P retrieval on held-out article queries.
physical_object: Eight learned 8-token Pythia soft prompts reused across query contexts
mirror_coordinate: For each query, m is the two-element softmax similarity code over the top-2 prompt keys; the logical prompt is the weighted sum of those pool entries
controls: oracle correct per-task prompt (quality upper bound)
native L2P-style top-2 softmax-weighted prompt composition
Mirror top-2 composition with the same fixed coordinate equation

routing.query_feature: mean final hidden state of frozen Pythia over the 64-token query context
routing.pool_key: mean final hidden state over the first 64 content tokens of each source article
routing.mirror_m: softmax of the two selected cosine similarities divided by temperature

evaluation.metric: target-token NLL; also report top-1 routing accuracy and top-2 target containment

development.selection_metric: NLL, routing accuracy, actual prompt+key bank bytes, per-query m bytes, routing/composition/inference time

paid_objects: eight full prompt vectors once per bank
any persistent router state; none is trained in this protocol

compute.prompt_training_cost: prior MA-591 bank training; reported separately and not recharged as new optimization

success_gate: Both bank seeds: Mirror NLL within +0.05 nat/token of oracle prompt and at least 0.02 nat better than native top-1; actual payload <=1.05x one full prompt pool plus keys; no exact native weighted-prompt alias.
failure_gate: Any quality/byte miss or exact native top-2 weighted-composition alias.
boundaries: The prompt pool is inherited from the already completed MA-591 development banks; no task prompt is retrained here
This is an eight-article text routing screen, not class-incremental vision evaluation
Top-2 softmax weighting is explicitly compared as the native composition control
Fresh task queries remain sealed after any gate miss or exact native alias
